summary: Implemented backend auth API with registration, login, password reset request, and password reset endpoints. Created utility modules for bcrypt password hashing (salt rounds 10), JWT token generation (24h expiry, SECRET_KEY signed), and an in-memory user store keyed by phone_number. Registration validates North America/Europe phone formats. Login returns JWT on success or 401 on failure. Password reset generates a 6-digit code with 15-minute expiry and sends it via the existing Textbelt SMS integration.
